source_references.title: Environmental Fate MCP governed scalar erosion/sediment validation profile

quality_flags.message: Matched record count is below the governed screening-plausible evidence threshold for this validation profile.

limitations.message: Validation fit classifications are screening QA diagnostics only; they are not calibration, parameter fitting, regulatory acceptance, or proof of scientific adequacy.
This workflow compares caller-supplied observed and predicted records without optimizing RUSLE/MUSLE factors, hydrology, delivery ratios, or availability fractions.
Fit classifications are reviewer-facing screening diagnostics, not calibration, optimization, regulatory acceptance, or proof of scientific adequacy.
Observed and predicted records are paired only by record_id and supported scalar quantity; spatial routing, rainfall-runoff generation, and WEPP execution remain out of scope.
Default thresholds are governance thresholds for scalar screening QA and must not be treated as universal watershed model performance criteria.

interpretation_lines: Observed and predicted erosion/sediment records were paired by record_id only.
Use the fit assessment as a screening QA check, not as calibration or acceptance.
